title: Difficult to Use
text: Difficult to Use. I found the 100pcs Resealable Mylar Bags for food storage very difficult to use. I have used other brands and they do well with my machine, but this failed to seal well. They would otherwise be very thick and sturdy. They are packaged well and arrived in good condition.

product_metadata.title: 100pcs Resealable Mylar Bags for food storage with stickers - Resealable Ziplock Pouch Bag, Edible Packaging with Double Side Aluminum Foil, 3 sizes - 40-11.3"x8.5", 30-9.3"x6.3", 30-7.8"x4.7"
features: Food grade material: Mylar food storage bags are made of high quality and non-toxic material. These are perfectly safe for storing food items. Our sealable bags are made of aluminum foil, which is a chemically inert material in normal conditions so that means your food will remain healthy and fresh inside these bags

Resealable and Reusable: These mylar ziplock bags are resealable and reusable. Conveniently put the contents inside with the stand-up design and use the ziplock to safely store these items. These bags are also heat sealable with a heat sealer or a small hair straightener. The ziplock seal and the heat seal can be used multiple times.

Long storage: With these sealed bags you can store your items for a long time and be confident that these bags will keep your items safely inside without absorbing any odor. These smell proof baggies are also leak-proof once sealed. You can rest assured the contents will remain safe and healthy in these bags

Excellent Quality: These cute packaging bags not only look good but are also very durable. Made of aluminum foil, these packaging bags are tough and durable. These will last you a long time without wearing down through extended usage. These bags are tear-resistant so they can handle a little rough use!

Wide Application: These bags can be used to store edible items such as coffee beans, cookies, candies, other items such as beads, buttons, and even be used for beauty items like eyelashes and lip gloss packaging. These can also be used as sample bags to seal, store and sort your samples
description: These reusable food storage bags are perfect for storing and organizing your products. We use non-toxic and safe material for these bags so that you can store edible items. With a light-proof, smell proof, and leakproof heat seal, the freshness of your items can be preserved for a long time.

These bags are resealable, so you can use them multiple times. The heat seal can ensure leakproof sealing for storing food items and other oxygen and light-sensitive items. These bags are easy to use with the convenient stand-up design, you can put the content inside without a hassle.

A mylar bag can be used to store a wide number of things ranging from food items such as dry foods, dry fruits, grains, coffee beans, to other miscellaneous items like buttons, beads, and beauty items. Mylar bags are perfect for lipgloss packaging and storing other small and sensitive beauty items. With strong aluminum foil so you can rest assured the contents will be safe inside. The resealable mylar bags are tear-resistant so these will be usable for a long time.
